blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine Economic Zone Authority (Peza) has exceeded its full-year target, as approved investments from January to October already reached P309.63 billion. That performance also puts Peza closer to beating its full-year investment approval record of P311.9 billion set in 2012. READ: Ecozone investments poised for banner 2026, says Peza On Thursday, the agency’s data showed that manufacturing remained the dominant investment sector with 92 projects, followed by information technology and business process management ventures at 40 and logistics projects at 21.
